definition_zh: 结合；联合；兼有；联合收割机
definition_en: to join two or more things so that they work or exist together, or to have two qualities at the same time
core_image: 两股溪流在山脚汇成一条更宽的河
scene: 两支小队伍把各自的工具摆到一处，合力搭起一座桥。They combined their tools and built the bridge in a day.
sceneCN: 这里 combine 指「结合；联合」（第 1 个义项：把事物合在一起）；句意是他们把工具合在一起，一天就搭好了桥。

senses.title: To join two things
senses.definition: to put two or more things together so that they form one whole
senses.definitionCN: 把两样或更多事物放在一起，使它们成为一个整体
senses.example: Combine the flour and the sugar in a large bowl.
senses.exampleCN: 把面粉和糖放进一个大碗里拌匀。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical: two things are brought into one place.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是具体的：把两样东西带到同一个地方。

senses.title: To have two qualities
senses.definition: to have two different qualities or roles at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同时具备两种不同的性质或身份
senses.example: Her job combines teaching with research.
senses.exampleCN: 她的工作兼有教学与研究。
senses.why: When two roles meet in one person, they are combined rather than mixed.
senses.whyCN: 两种身份集中在一个人身上，是结合而非混杂。

senses.title: A harvesting machine
senses.definition: a large farm machine that cuts and cleans grain in one pass
senses.definitionCN: 一次完成收割与脱粒的大型农业机械
senses.example: The combine moved slowly across the wheat field.
senses.exampleCN: 联合收割机缓缓驶过麦田。
senses.why: The machine does several farm jobs at once, so it is named after combining.
senses.whyCN: 这台机器一次完成好几道农活，因此以「联合」命名。

intro.en: Combine goes back to Latin combinare, a word for joining two things into one.
intro.cn: combine 上溯到拉丁语 combinare，意为把两样东西并成一体。

items.en: Combinare built on com-, together, and bini, two each.
items.cn: combinare 由表示一起的 com- 与表示各两个的 bini 构成。

items.en: Scribes used combinare for uniting separate things.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语文献用 combinare 表示把分开的事物联合起来。

items.en: Old French combiner kept the same practical sense.
items.cn: 古法语 combiner 保留了同样务实的含义。

items.en: English combine entered use for joining forces or ideas.
items.cn: 英语 combine 开始用于联合力量或想法。

items.en: Farmers gave the name combine to a machine that harvests and threshes.
items.cn: 农人把收割与脱粒一体的机器称作 combine。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words that echo the spelling of combine, and the meaning group lists other verbs of joining.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写与 combine 相近的短词，近义组列出其他表示结合的动词。

fighting between armed forces
to say that you are unhappy about something
to join two things so that they become one
to join together for a shared aim
to mix things smoothly into one
entries.definitionCN: 把事物平滑地混成一体

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two streams meeting, then move to shared work and to the machine that does many jobs at once.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两条溪流相汇开始，再走到合力做事以及一次完成多道工序的机器。

normal.en: Com- means together, so combine always needs at least two things.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，所以 combine 至少需要两样东西。

normal.en: Combine is the act and combination is the result.
normal.cn: combine 是动作，combination 是结果。

normal.en: A job that combines teaching and research pays two ways at once.
normal.cn: 一份兼有教学与研究的工作，一次收获两样。

normal.en: The farm machine keeps its verb name because it joins several jobs.
normal.cn: 那台农机沿用动词的名字，因为它把好几道工序合在一起。

normal.en: Two streams become one river, and neither loses its water.
normal.cn: 两条溪流汇成一条河，谁的水都没有少。

abstract.en: Picture two ropes twisted into a single stronger cord.
abstract.cn: 想象两股绳子拧成一根更结实的索。

abstract.en: Picture one person carrying a bag in each hand up the stairs.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人两手各提一个袋子走上楼梯。

abstract.en: Picture a harvester sweeping a field and leaving clean grain behind.
abstract.cn: 想象收割机扫过田野，身后留下干净的谷粒。

examples.en: Combine the eggs with the milk and stir well.
examples.cn: 把鸡蛋和牛奶混合，搅拌均匀。

examples.en: The new role combines design and sales.
examples.cn: 这个新职位兼有设计与销售。

examples.en: Farmers hired a combine to gather the grain.
examples.cn: 农民租了一台联合收割机来收谷子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 combine 记成 com（一起）加 bine：两股绳子一起拧，就成了更结实的一股。

root: 源自拉丁语 combinare，com- 表示一起，bini 表示各两个，本义是把两样东西并成一体，后引申为兼有与联合收割机。

sensesIntro.en: From joining two things, to holding two roles, and finally to a machine that joins several farm jobs.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把两样东西合起来，到同时兼有两种身份，再到把几道农活合在一起的机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two streams meeting at the foot of a hill and flowing on as one wider river.
core.cn: 核心意象：两股溪流在山脚汇成一条更宽的河。

branches.en: Physical joining is the oldest and clearest sense.
branches.cn: 具体的结合是最古老也最清楚的义项。

branches.en: Two roles in one person are joined rather than mixed.
branches.cn: 两种身份集于一人，是结合而不是混杂。

branches.en: The machine carries the name because it joins several jobs.
branches.cn: 那台机器得名，是因为它把几道工序合在一起。

branches.en: Both senses keep the idea of two things sharing one place.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留着两样东西共处一处的意思。

branches.en: A harvester combines cutting and threshing the way two hands work together.
branches.cn: 收割机把割与脱粒合在一起，就像两只手配合。

intro.en: Combine is a free base that takes endings to mark tense and to build nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: combine 是自由词基，靠词尾变化表示时态，并构成名词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base combinare supplied both the verb and the noun family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 combinare 同时供给了动词与名词两个家族。

items.example: The plan combines speed with safety.
items.exampleCN: 这个方案把速度与安全结合起来。

items.example: The two teams combined for the final match.
items.exampleCN: 两支队伍为了决赛联合起来。

items.example: She is combining two old tables into one.
items.exampleCN: 她正把两张旧桌子拼成一张。

items.example: The dish is a combination of sweet and sour.
items.exampleCN: 这道菜是酸甜的结合。

items.example: The lock accepts only a few combinations.
items.exampleCN: 这把锁只接受少数几种密码组合。

items.example: The two parts are combinable without glue.
items.exampleCN: 这两个部件不用胶就能接合。

items.meaning: a fresh joining of existing parts
items.example: The lab studies recombination in cells.
items.exampleCN: 实验室研究细胞中的重组。

items.meaning: a person or device that joins things
items.example: The device acts as a signal combiner.
items.exampleCN: 这个设备起着信号合并器的作用。

definition_en: to move towards the speaker or a stated place, to arrive somewhere, or to happen in time
core_image: 远处的人一步步走近，最后站到你面前
scene: 门铃响了，孩子从楼上冲下来开门。She came home late after the meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 come 指「来；到来」（第 1 个义项：朝说话人移动）；句意是她开完会后很晚才到家。

senses.title: To move towards
senses.definition: to move towards the person speaking or towards a stated place
senses.definitionCN: 朝说话的人或某个指定地点移动
senses.example: Come here and look at this photograph.
senses.exampleCN: 过来看看这张照片。
senses.why: The oldest sense is plain movement towards the speaker, the centre of the scene.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是朝说话人移动，而说话人正是场景的中心。

senses.title: To arrive
senses.definition: to reach a place, especially after travelling some distance
senses.definitionCN: 经过一段路程后抵达某地
senses.example: The train came into the station at six.
senses.exampleCN: 火车六点进站。
senses.why: A journey ends where the speaker is, so moving towards becomes arriving.
senses.whyCN: 旅程的终点就在说话人所在之处，于是「过来」变成了「到达」。

senses.title: To happen or appear
senses.definition: to happen, or to appear at a particular time or in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 发生，或在某个时间以某种方式出现
senses.example: Spring comes early in this valley.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷里春天来得早。
senses.why: Time and seasons also arrive, so the word widens from walking to happening.
senses.whyCN: 时间与季节也会「到来」，这个词便从走路扩展到发生。

intro.en: Come is one of the oldest English verbs, going back to Old English cuman.
intro.cn: come 是英语最古老的动词之一，可上溯到古英语 cuman。

items.en: Cuman meant to move towards a person or place.
items.cn: cuman 意为朝某人或某地移动。

items.en: Related verbs in German and Dutch show one common ancestor.
items.cn: 德语与荷兰语中的相关动词说明它们同出一源。

items.en: The spelling settled into come while the past form came took shape.
items.cn: 中古英语时期拼写定为 come，过去式 came 也逐渐成形。

items.en: Writers stretched it to arrivals and to events that happen.
items.cn: 作家把它扩展到抵达，以及发生的事件。

items.en: Everyday phrases such as come true and come from fixed it in speech.
items.cn: 诸如实现、来自这样的日常说法把它牢牢固定在口语里。

note.en: The look-alike group collects short words near the spelling of come, while the meaning group lists other verbs of reaching a place.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 come 拼写相近的短词，近义组列出其他表示抵达的动词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a person walking closer, then move to arriving at a station and to seasons that arrive.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从有人走近开始，再走到进站与季节的到来。

normal.en: Come points at the speaker: the movement always ends here.
normal.cn: come 指向说话人：这个动作总是结束在此处。

normal.en: The past form came is irregular, but it keeps the same open vowel sound.
normal.cn: 过去式 came 虽不规则，却保留了同样开阔的元音。

normal.en: A train comes into a station, and a season comes to a valley.
normal.cn: 火车进站，季节也来到山谷。

normal.en: Come true means a hope finally arrives as a fact.
normal.cn: come true 指一个愿望终于作为事实到来。

normal.en: Coming is both the act of arriving and the thing that is next.
normal.cn: coming 既是到来的动作，也指即将来临的事物。

abstract.en: Picture a friend waving from the far end of a platform.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友在站台尽头挥手。

abstract.en: Picture the first warm wind of spring reaching a cold valley.
abstract.cn: 想象春天的第一阵暖风吹进寒冷的山谷。

abstract.en: Picture a wish quietly turning into a real shop with a sign.
abstract.cn: 想象一个愿望悄悄变成挂着招牌的真店铺。

examples.en: Come and sit beside me for a while.
examples.cn: 过来在我旁边坐一会儿。

examples.en: She came back with good news.
examples.cn: 她带着好消息回来了。

examples.en: His dream of owning a shop came true at last.
examples.cn: 他开一家店的心愿终于实现了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 come 记成「走过来」：远处的人一步步靠近，最后站到你面前，就是来。

root: 古英语 cuman 的直接继承，与德语、荷兰语的相关动词同源，本义是朝某人移动，后扩展为抵达与发生。

sensesIntro.en: From walking towards the speaker, to reaching a station, and finally to seasons and events arriving.
sensesIntro.cn: 从朝说话人走来，到抵达车站，再到季节与事件的到来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person walking closer until standing right in front of you.
core.cn: 核心意象：远处的人一步步走近，最后站到你面前。

branches.en: Walking towards the speaker is the root sense.
branches.cn: 朝说话人走来是这个词的根本义。

branches.en: Arriving is the same movement seen at its end.
branches.cn: 到达是同一条移动轨迹看到终点时的说法。

branches.en: Seasons and events also come without feet.
branches.cn: 季节与事件不用脚，也会到来。

branches.en: Movement and arrival need only a listener as the goal.
branches.cn: 移动与抵达只需要一个听话的人作目标。

branches.en: A train and a spring both show up on time.
branches.cn: 火车与春天都按时现身。

intro.en: Come is a free base with irregular forms, and it also builds many short compound nouns.
intro.cn: come 是带不规则变化的自由词基，也能构成许多简短复合名词。

latinIntro.en: The word has no Latin origin; it comes straight from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁来源，直接传自古英语。

items.example: She comes to work by bike.
items.exampleCN: 她骑车来上班。

items.example: They came early and waited outside.
items.exampleCN: 他们来得早，在外面等。

items.example: The coming winter will be cold.
items.exampleCN: 即将到来的冬天会很冷。

items.example: The first comer got the best seat.
items.exampleCN: 最先来的人坐到了最好的位子。

items.example: The singer made a comeback last year.
items.exampleCN: 这位歌手去年复出了。

items.meaning: the result that comes out of an event
items.example: No one could predict the outcome.
items.exampleCN: 没人能预料结果。

items.example: Her income rose after the promotion.
items.exampleCN: 升职后她的收入增加了。

items.meaning: a person who has recently come
items.example: The newcomer asked for directions.
items.exampleCN: 新来的人问了路。

definition_zh: 舒适；安逸；安慰；安慰（动词）
definition_en: a pleasant state of physical ease, kind words that make someone feel better, or to make someone feel less sad
core_image: 疲惫时陷进沙发里那口长长的叹气
scene: 她把热水袋塞进被窝，冰冷的双脚慢慢暖起来。A warm blanket brought comfort on the cold night.
sceneCN: 这里 comfort 指「舒适；安逸」（第 1 个义项：身体上的安适）；句意是一条暖毯在寒夜里带来了舒适。

collocations.zh: 起不了多少作用的安慰

senses.title: A state of ease
senses.definition: a pleasant state in which you feel relaxed and free from pain
senses.definitionCN: 身体放松、没有痛楚的愉快状态
senses.example: The soft chair gave her back some comfort.
senses.exampleCN: 这把软椅让她的背舒服了一些。
senses.why: The first sense is about the body, since the old word meant to strengthen.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项关乎身体，因为这个词原意是使人变得强壮。

senses.title: Consolation
senses.definition: kind words or actions that make someone feel less sad
senses.definitionCN: 让人不那么难过的贴心话语或举动
senses.example: His letter was a great comfort to her.
senses.exampleCN: 他的来信给了她很大的安慰。
senses.why: Strength passes from one person to another, so comfort becomes solace.
senses.whyCN: 力量从一个人传到另一个人身上，舒适便成了安慰。

senses.title: To console
senses.definition: to make someone feel less sad or worried
senses.definitionCN: 使某人少一些悲伤或担忧
senses.example: She comforted the crying child.
senses.exampleCN: 她安慰着那个哭泣的孩子。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb: to give someone comfort.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：把舒适与安慰给出去。

intro.en: Comfort comes from Latin confortare, which meant to strengthen greatly.
intro.cn: comfort 来自拉丁语 confortare，本义是大大地增强力量。

items.en: Confortare joined com-, strongly, with fortis, meaning strong.
items.cn: confortare 把表示强化的 com- 与意为强壮的 fortis 结合。

items.en: The word was used for giving fresh strength to a tired person.
items.cn: 这个词用于给疲惫的人重新注入力量。

items.en: Old French conforter carried both help and encouragement.
items.cn: 古法语 conforter 兼有援助与鼓励之意。

items.en: English comfort first meant to strengthen or cheer.
items.cn: 英语 comfort 最初表示使强健或使振奋。

items.en: The sense of bodily ease and soft furnishings came later.
items.cn: 身体安适与柔软陈设的含义是后来才有的。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs that share the opening of comfort, while the meaning group names ease and consolation.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comfort 开头相同的动词，近义组列出安适与安慰。

the state of being free from pain or worry
entries.definitionCN: 没有痛苦或忧虑的状态

entries.definition: something that makes you feel better after loss
entries.definitionCN: 失去之后让人好受些的东西

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a body at rest, then move to words that console and to the act of consoling.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从身体得到休息开始，再走到安慰的话语与安慰的动作。

normal.en: The Latin fortis means strong, so comfort is strength handed to someone.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 fortis 意为强壮，所以 comfort 是递给别人的力量。

normal.en: Soft chairs, warm blankets and hot drinks all deliver comfort.
normal.cn: 软椅、暖毯和热饮都在传递舒适。

normal.en: Cold comfort is a help that hardly helps at all.
normal.cn: 冷安慰是指几乎起不了作用的帮助。

normal.en: Your comfort zone is the place where nothing pushes you.
normal.cn: 舒适区就是没有东西推着你的那个地方。

normal.en: Comfort as a verb always takes a person as its object.
normal.cn: comfort 作动词时，宾语总是人。

abstract.en: Picture sinking into a sofa after a long bus ride.
abstract.cn: 想象长途汽车之后陷进沙发。

abstract.en: Picture a hand resting on a shaking shoulder.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手轻轻搭在颤抖的肩上。

abstract.en: Picture a warm drink placed silently on a cold desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯热饮被悄悄放在冰冷的桌上。

examples.en: The fire gave the small room a gentle comfort.
examples.cn: 炉火给这个小房间带来一种柔和的舒适。

examples.en: She comforted him with a few quiet words.
examples.cn: 她用几句轻声的话安慰了他。

examples.en: They now live in comfort by the sea.
examples.cn: 他们现在在海边过着安逸的生活。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comfort 记成 com（一起）加 fort（堡垒）：一起躲进堡垒里，就有了舒适与安慰。

root: 源自拉丁语 confortare，com- 表强化，fortis 表强壮，本义是给人添力，后转为身体的安适与心里的安慰。

sensesIntro.en: From strength given to a tired body, to ease of body, then to consolation and the act of consoling.
sensesIntro.cn: 从给疲惫之躯添力，到身体的安适，再到安慰与安慰的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sinking into a sofa and letting out a long breath of relief.
core.cn: 核心意象：疲惫时陷进沙发里那口长长的叹气。

branches.en: Bodily ease is the sense most people meet first today.
branches.cn: 身体的安适是今天多数人最先接触到的义项。

branches.en: Consolation is ease given to a wounded heart.
branches.cn: 安慰是给受伤的心送去的安适。

branches.en: The verb is simply the act of handing comfort over.
branches.cn: 动词义就是把舒适递出去的动作。

branches.en: Soft things and kind words both answer the same tiredness.
branches.cn: 柔软的东西与温柔的话语回应的是同一种疲惫。

branches.en: One can comfort only by first noticing another's pain.
branches.cn: 只有先看见别人的痛，才谈得上安慰。

intro.en: Comfort is a free base that grows with -able, -ing and the negative prefix dis-.
intro.cn: comfort 是自由词基，靠 -able、-ing 与否定前缀 dis- 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Its Latin root fortis, strong, also hides inside fortress and fortify.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词根 fortis 意为强壮，也藏在 fortress 与 fortify 之中。

items.example: The old man enjoyed the comforts of home.
items.exampleCN: 老人享受着家里的种种舒适。

items.example: The child was comforted by her voice.
items.exampleCN: 孩子被她的声音安抚了。

items.meaning: the act of consoling, or making one feel better

items.meaning: giving ease or feeling at ease

items.exampleCN: 这床又软又舒适。

items.meaning: in an easy and relaxed way
items.example: He slept comfortably all night.
items.exampleCN: 他整夜睡得很安稳。

items.meaning: a person who consoles or a thick warm cover
items.example: She pulled the comforter up to her chin.
items.exampleCN: 她把厚被子拉到下巴。

items.meaning: a slight pain or awkward feeling
items.example: He felt a mild discomfort in his knee.
items.exampleCN: 他觉得膝盖有点不适。

items.meaningCN: 没有温暖的；缺乏安慰的
items.example: The room felt cold and comfortless.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间又冷又让人不安。

definition_en: making you feel physically relaxed, feeling calm and not worried, or having enough money to live well
core_image: 陷进软椅，肩膀终于松下来的那一刻
scene: 换上新鞋后，他走了整整一天也不觉得累。These shoes are comfortable enough for a long walk.
sceneCN: 这里 comfortable 指「舒适的」（第 1 个义项：身体感到舒服）；句意是这双鞋足够舒适，能走很远的路。

senses.title: Giving physical ease
senses.definition: pleasant to wear, sit in or lie on because it causes no pain
senses.definitionCN: 穿、坐或躺起来舒服，不会带来痛楚
senses.example: The hotel room had a comfortable bed.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店房间里有一张舒适的床。
senses.why: The ending -able turns comfort into something that can give comfort.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -able 把 comfort 变成能够给出舒适的东西。

senses.title: Relaxed and not worried
senses.definition: feeling calm and at ease with people or in a situation
senses.definitionCN: 与人相处或身处某种情境时感到平静放松
senses.example: She felt comfortable among old friends.
senses.exampleCN: 她在老朋友中间感到自在。
senses.why: The ease of the body spreads to the mind, so a person can be comfortable too.
senses.whyCN: 身体的安适蔓延到心里，于是人本身也可以感到自在。

senses.title: Having enough money
senses.definition: having enough money to live well without worrying
senses.definitionCN: 钱够用，生活无忧
senses.example: They are comfortable but not rich.
senses.exampleCN: 他们手头宽裕，但并不富有。
senses.why: Money removes daily worry, so a budget can be described as comfortable.
senses.whyCN: 钱能消除日常的忧虑，所以一份预算也能用「宽裕」来形容。

intro.en: Comfortable is comfort plus the ending -able, which marks something able to give.
intro.cn: comfortable 由 comfort 加后缀 -able 构成，表示能够给予某种东西。

items.en: Confortare meant to strengthen greatly.
items.cn: confortare 意为大大增强力量。

items.en: Old French conforter supplied the noun comfort.
items.cn: 古法语 conforter 提供了名词 comfort。

items.en: Comfort first meant strength and encouragement.
items.cn: 英语 comfort 最初表示力量与鼓励。

items.en: Comfortable was applied to chairs, beds and rooms.
items.cn: comfortable 开始用于椅子、床与房间。

items.en: It widened again to feelings of ease and to money matters.
items.cn: 它又扩展到自在的心情与钱财状况。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers adjectives ending in -able, and the meaning group lists words for physical and social ease.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同样以 -able 结尾的形容词，近义组列出身体与社交上的安适。

entries.definition: able to be compared with something else
making you feel calmer and less sad
popular in style at a certain time
warm, soft and pleasant
small, warm and sheltered
calm and free from worry

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a body at ease, then move to a calm mind and to a purse that is not tight.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从身体的安适开始，再走到平静的心与不紧张的钱包。

normal.en: The ending -able means able to give, so comfortable is able to give comfort.
normal.cn: 后缀 -able 意为能给予，所以 comfortable 就是能给出舒适。

normal.en: A comfortable chair is one your back forgets about.
normal.cn: 舒适的椅子，是你的背会忘记它存在的那把。

normal.en: Feeling comfortable with people means no mask is needed.
normal.cn: 和人相处感到自在，意味着不必戴面具。

normal.en: A comfortable income pays the bills without counting coins.
normal.cn: 宽裕的收入让你不必数着硬币付账。

normal.en: Add un- and the whole meaning turns over.
normal.cn: 加上否定前缀 un-，整个意思就翻了过来。

abstract.en: Picture a deep armchair swallowing your tired shoulders.
abstract.cn: 想象一把深陷的扶手椅吞下你疲惫的肩膀。

abstract.en: Picture a quiet kitchen where no one hurries you.
abstract.cn: 想象一间安静的厨房，没人催你。

abstract.en: Picture a full fridge and a paid bill on the table.
abstract.cn: 想象冰箱满满的，桌上是付清的账单。

examples.en: This chair is comfortable for long hours of reading.
examples.cn: 这把椅子很舒服，适合长时间读书。

examples.en: He felt comfortable enough to ask questions.
examples.cn: 他自在得敢于提问了。

examples.en: They live a comfortable life in the countryside.
examples.cn: 他们在乡下过着宽裕的生活。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comfortable 记成 comfort（舒适）加 able（能够）：能够让人舒适的东西，就是舒适的。

root: 由 comfort 加后缀 -able 构成，词根可上溯拉丁语 confortare（大大增强），本义是能给人添力与安适的。

sensesIntro.en: From a bed that gives ease, to a mind at ease, and finally to a wallet that is not tight.
sensesIntro.cn: 从让人舒服的床，到放松的心，再到不紧张的钱包。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sinking into a soft chair and letting the shoulders drop.
core.cn: 核心意象：陷进软椅，肩膀终于松下来的那一刻。

branches.en: A surface that gives no pain is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 不会带来痛楚的表面，是最日常的义项。

branches.en: Ease moves from the body into how a person feels with others.
branches.cn: 安适从身体转移到人与人相处时的感受。

branches.en: Money that covers needs buys a kind of comfort too.
branches.cn: 够用的钱也买来一种舒适。

branches.en: A soft chair and easy company both remove tension.
branches.cn: 软椅与轻松的陪伴都在消除紧张。

branches.en: A person free of worry often has enough of both.
branches.cn: 无忧的人往往两样都不缺。

intro.en: Comfortable is a derived adjective, and its family works with -ly, un- and the base comfort.
intro.cn: comfortable 是派生形容词，它的家族靠 -ly、un- 与词基 comfort 运作。

latinIntro.en: The Latin fortis, strong, still shows through in the stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的 fortis 意为强壮，仍能从词干中看出来。

items.example: They sat comfortably around the fire.
items.exampleCN: 他们舒适地围坐在火边。

items.example: The seat was hard and uncomfortable.
items.exampleCN: 座位又硬又不舒服。

items.example: He laughed uncomfortably at the joke.
items.exampleCN: 他听到那个笑话不自在地笑了。

items.example: The blanket gave him warmth and comfort.
items.exampleCN: 毯子给了他温暖与舒适。

items.example: Her voice was low and comforting.
items.exampleCN: 她的声音低沉而令人宽慰。

items.meaning: a person or thing that comforts
items.example: The thick comforter kept out the cold.
items.exampleCN: 厚被子挡住了寒气。

items.example: The empty hall was cold and comfortless.
items.exampleCN: 空荡的大厅又冷又不舒服。

items.example: He missed the comforts of his own room.
items.exampleCN: 他想念自己房间里的种种舒适。

definition_en: an official order, control over a group of people, or to order someone to do something
core_image: 军官抬手一声令下，整队人同时转身
scene: 队长举起手，所有人立刻停下脚步。The officer gave a command and the soldiers stood still.
sceneCN: 这里 command 指「命令」（第 1 个义项：上级下达的指令）；句意是军官下达命令，士兵们站定不动。

senses.title: An official order
senses.definition: an order given by someone with authority
senses.definitionCN: 有权者下达的指令
senses.example: The general gave the command to advance.
senses.exampleCN: 将军下达了前进的命令。
senses.why: The earliest sense in English is a direct order from a leader.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在英语里最早的义项就是首领直接下达的指令。

senses.title: Control over a group
senses.definition: the power to direct people or a situation
senses.definitionCN: 指挥人员或掌控局面的权力
senses.example: She was in command of the whole fleet.
senses.exampleCN: 她指挥着整支舰队。
senses.why: Whoever gives the orders holds the power, so order becomes control.
senses.whyCN: 下达命令的人掌握着权力，于是命令变成了掌控。

senses.title: To order or deserve
senses.definition: to order someone to do something, or to deserve and receive respect
senses.definitionCN: 命令某人做事，或赢得并得到尊敬
senses.example: Her calm voice commanded respect.
senses.exampleCN: 她沉静的声音赢得了尊敬。
senses.why: Authority both issues orders and draws respect without asking.
senses.whyCN: 权威既下达命令，也不必请求就赢得尊敬。

intro.en: Command comes from Latin mandare, to entrust, strengthened by the prefix com-.
intro.cn: command 来自拉丁语 mandare（托付），并由前缀 com- 加强语气。

items.en: Mandare meant to hand something over or entrust a task.
items.cn: mandare 意为把东西交出去或把任务托付给人。

items.en: Commandare added com- and took on the sense of ordering.
items.cn: commandare 加上 com-，带上了下令的意味。

items.en: Old French comander meant to order and to entrust.
items.cn: 古法语 comander 兼有下令与托付之意。

items.en: English command entered as both a noun and a verb of authority.
items.cn: 英语 command 以名词与动词两种身份进入，都表示权威。

items.en: It widened to mastery of a language and to earning respect.
items.cn: 它的用法扩展到语言的掌握与赢得尊敬。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close in spelling to command, while the meaning group lists verbs of ordering and directing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 command 拼写相近的词，近义组列出下令与指挥的动词。

entries.definition: to praise someone formally
to ask for something firmly
a remark about something
to tell someone to do something
to give someone clear directions
to control or manage an activity

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a voice giving an order, then move to the power behind it and to the respect it earns.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一声下令开始，再走到命令背后的权力与它赢得的敬意。

normal.en: Com- plus mandare, to entrust, means a task handed down with authority.
normal.cn: com- 加 mandare（托付），指带着权威交办下去的任务。

normal.en: The one in command is the one whose words end discussion.
normal.cn: 处于指挥位置的人，话一出口讨论就结束。

normal.en: A good command of English means the language obeys you.
normal.cn: 良好的英语运用能力，意味着这门语言听你调遣。

normal.en: Command respect is respect you never had to ask for.
normal.cn: 赢得尊敬，是你从不必开口索要的尊敬。

normal.en: Commander adds -er and becomes the person who commands.
normal.cn: commander 加 -er，就成了下命令的那个人。

abstract.en: Picture a raised hand and a whole line turning at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手抬起，整排人同时转身。

abstract.en: Picture a map table lit by one lamp on a ship's bridge.
abstract.cn: 想象舰桥上被一盏灯照亮的地图桌。

abstract.en: Picture a room falling silent when one person begins to speak.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人开口时，整个房间安静下来。

examples.en: The captain gave a short command and the crew moved.
examples.cn: 船长下达了简短命令，船员们行动起来。

examples.en: She has a good command of three languages.
examples.cn: 她精通三门语言。

examples.en: His honesty commanded the trust of everyone there.
examples.cn: 他的诚实赢得了在场每个人的信任。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 command 记成 com（一起）加 mand（手）：手一挥，所有人一起动，就是命令。

root: 源自拉丁语 mandare（托付），加前缀 com- 后成 commandare，本义是把任务交办下去，后引申为命令、指挥与掌握。

sensesIntro.en: From an order spoken aloud, to the power that backs it, and finally to the respect and mastery it brings.
sensesIntro.cn: 从说出口的命令，到支撑它的权力，再到它带来的敬意与掌握。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an officer raising a hand and a whole line turning as one.
core.cn: 核心意象：军官抬手一声令下，整队人同时转身。

branches.en: The spoken order is the sense that entered English first.
branches.cn: 说出口的命令是最早进入英语的义项。

branches.en: Control is what makes an order more than a request.
branches.cn: 正因为有掌控力，命令才不只是请求。

branches.en: The verb covers both ordering people and earning respect.
branches.cn: 动词义既包括对人下令，也包括赢得尊敬。

branches.en: An order and the power behind it are two views of one act.
branches.cn: 命令与它背后的权力，是同一动作的两个视角。

branches.en: Mastery of a language is control without a single shout.
branches.cn: 对一门语言的掌握，是一声不喊的掌控。

intro.en: Command is a free base that forms agent nouns with -er and abstract nouns with -ment.
intro.cn: command 是自由词基，用 -er 构成施动者名词，用 -ment 构成抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mandare, to entrust, is the root shared with mandate and demand.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mandare（托付）是与 mandate、demand 共有的词根。

items.structure: plural noun and third person singular
items.meaning: several orders, or he gives an order
items.example: The system accepts voice commands.
items.exampleCN: 这个系统接受语音指令。

items.example: He commanded the unit for two years.
items.exampleCN: 他指挥这支部队两年。

items.example: She has a commanding voice.
items.exampleCN: 她的嗓音很有威严。

items.example: The commander studied the map.
items.exampleCN: 指挥官研究了地图。

items.example: Several commanders met at the base.
items.exampleCN: 几位指挥官在基地会面。

items.meaning: the officer in charge of a place
items.example: The commandant inspected the camp.
items.exampleCN: 司令视察了营地。

items.example: The old commandment forbids stealing.
items.exampleCN: 古老的戒律禁止偷窃。

items.example: He spoke commandingly to the crowd.
items.exampleCN: 他威严地对人群讲话。

definition_zh: 评论；意见；注释；评论（动词）
definition_en: a spoken or written remark about someone or something, a note explaining a text, or to make such a remark
core_image: 看完文章后在页边写下的一行小字
scene: 视频下面，网友留下一条简短的评价。He read the comment and smiled.
sceneCN: 这里 comment 指「评论；意见」（第 1 个义项：对事物的看法）；句意是他读了那条评论，笑了笑。

senses.title: A remark
senses.definition: something that you say or write to give your opinion
senses.definitionCN: 为表达看法而说或写的话
senses.example: He made a kind comment about her cooking.
senses.exampleCN: 他对她的厨艺说了句善意的评论。
senses.why: The everyday sense is a short remark offered to others.
senses.whyCN: 最日常的义项就是向别人说出的简短评语。

senses.title: A note explaining a text
senses.definition: a note added to a text to explain a difficult word or passage
senses.definitionCN: 加在文本旁解释难词或难句的注记
senses.example: The editor added a comment in the margin.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑在页边加了一条注释。
senses.why: Scholars first wrote comments beside old books to explain them.
senses.whyCN: 学者最早在古书旁写注，用来解释原文。

senses.title: To remark
senses.definition: to say something that gives your opinion about a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 说出对某人或某事的看法
senses.example: Several readers commented on the article.
senses.exampleCN: 几位读者对这篇文章发表了评论。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb: to offer a comment.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：把一条评论给出去。

intro.en: Comment comes from Latin commentum, a note or invention, built on comminisci, to devise.
intro.cn: comment 来自拉丁语 commentum（注记、构想），源自 comminisci（想出、构思）。

items.en: Comminisci meant to think up or devise something.
items.cn: comminisci 意为想出或构思出某物。

items.en: Commentum named a written note that explained a text.
items.cn: commentum 指解释文本的书面注记。

items.en: Old French coment kept the scholarly sense of a note.
items.cn: 古法语 coment 保留了注记的学术含义。

items.en: English comment first meant an explanatory note.
items.cn: 英语 comment 最初指解释性的注释。

items.en: It widened to any remark of opinion, spoken or posted online.
items.cn: 它的范围扩展到任何表达看法的话，无论口说还是网上发布。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words close in shape to comment, while the meaning group gives other words for a remark.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comment 形状相近的词，近义组给出其他表示评语的词。

entries.definition: an icy body that moves around the sun
to begin something formal
a powder that hardens when mixed with water
something you say to express a thought
a spoken or written note based on watching
a short written record or explanation

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a line written in a margin, then move to remarks about people and to posting a reply online.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从页边写下的一行字开始，再走到对人的评语与网上发帖回复。

normal.en: A comment is short by nature: one thought, one line.
normal.cn: 评论天生简短：一个想法，一行字。

normal.en: No comment is a complete answer in the news world.
normal.cn: 在新闻界，无可奉告就是一个完整的回答。

normal.en: Comment on takes the topic after on, not after of.
normal.cn: 表示评论某事时，用 comment on 而不是 of。

normal.en: Commentary is the long version, commentator is the person.
normal.cn: commentary 是长篇的评论，commentator 是评论的人。

normal.en: Margins of old books are full of comments in faded ink.
normal.cn: 古书的页边写满了褪色墨水的注释。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil writing a small note beside a hard sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象铅笔在一个难句旁写下小注。

abstract.en: Picture a screen filling with short replies under a video.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上一个视频下方涌满简短回复。

abstract.en: Picture a reporter waiting and receiving only silence.
abstract.cn: 想象记者等着，却只得到沉默。

examples.en: Her comment on the plan was short and kind.
examples.cn: 她对这份计划的评论简短而友善。

examples.en: The teacher wrote a comment beside each essay.
examples.cn: 老师在每篇作文旁写了批注。

examples.en: Many readers commented under the story.
examples.cn: 许多读者在报道下面发表了评论。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comment 记成「写在小纸条上的话」：看完别人的东西，随手留一句，就是评论。

root: 源自拉丁语 commentum（注记、构想），出自 comminisci（想出），本义是在文本旁写下的解释，后泛指一切表达看法的话。

sensesIntro.en: From a note in the margin, to a remark about a person, and finally to posting an opinion online.
sensesIntro.cn: 从页边的注记，到对人的评语，再到网上发布看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of small handwriting added beside a printed page.
core.cn: 核心意象：看完文章后在页边写下的一行小字。

branches.en: A short remark is the sense used most today.
branches.cn: 简短的评语是今天用得最多的义项。

branches.en: The scholarly margin note is the oldest written sense.
branches.cn: 学术性的页边注是最早的书面义项。

branches.en: The verb simply means to put a comment into words.
branches.cn: 动词义就是把一条评论说出来。

branches.en: Both a spoken remark and a written note add a voice to a text.
branches.cn: 口头的评语与书面的注记，都是给文本添上一个声音。

branches.en: Noun and verb differ only in whether the remark is out yet.
branches.cn: 名词与动词的差别，只在于那句话有没有说出口。

intro.en: Comment grows into a family with -ary, -ator and -ate, all about explaining or judging.
intro.cn: comment 靠 -ary、-ator 与 -ate 长成一个家族，都与解释或评判有关。

latinIntro.en: The Latin commentum links the word to mental invention as well as to notes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 commentum 把这个词同时连向头脑的构想与书面的注记。

items.structure: plural noun and third person singular
items.example: The page received hundreds of comments.
items.exampleCN: 这个页面收到了数百条评论。

items.example: She commented that the room was too warm.
items.exampleCN: 她评论说房间太热了。

items.example: He was commenting on the match.
items.exampleCN: 他正在评论那场比赛。

items.meaning: a continuous explanation or set of comments
items.example: The radio commentary described every pass.
items.exampleCN: 电台解说描述了每一次传球。

items.meaning: a person who comments, especially on events
items.example: The commentator knew every player.
items.exampleCN: 解说员认识每一位球员。

items.meaning: to describe an event as it happens
items.example: She commentates on tennis matches.
items.exampleCN: 她为网球比赛做解说。

items.meaning: the place where sports commentators sit
items.example: The commentary box overlooks the field.
items.exampleCN: 解说席俯瞰着球场。

items.meaning: a person who leaves comments online
items.example: One commenter asked a fair question.
items.exampleCN: 一位留言者提了个公允的问题。

definition_zh: 商业的；营利性的；电视广告
definition_en: connected with buying and selling, made in order to earn money, or an advertisement on television or radio
core_image: 电视节目被一段广告突然打断的那三十秒
scene: 节目演到一半，屏幕切进一段广告。The commercial broke the film into three parts.
sceneCN: 这里 commercial 指「电视广告」（第 3 个义项：插播的广告片）；句意是这段广告把影片切成了三段。

senses.title: Related to trade
senses.definition: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 与货物和服务的买卖有关的
senses.example: The city has a large commercial district.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市有一大片商业区。
senses.why: The ending -ial turns the noun commerce into an adjective of relation.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ial 把名词 commerce 变成表示关联的形容词。

senses.title: Made to earn money
senses.definition: produced or run in order to make a profit rather than to help
senses.definitionCN: 为获取利润而非出于公益而制作或经营的
senses.example: The project was purely commercial in its aims.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目的目的纯粹是营利。
senses.why: Trade exists to make money, so the adjective also judges motives.
senses.whyCN: 买卖本就是为了赚钱，所以这个形容词也用来评判动机。

senses.title: An advertisement
senses.definition: a short advertisement on television or radio
senses.definitionCN: 电视或广播中播放的短广告
senses.example: The commercial lasted only twenty seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 这则广告只持续了二十秒。
senses.why: Broadcasters shortened the phrase commercial message into one word.
senses.whyCN: 广播机构把「商业信息」这一说法缩成了一个词。

intro.en: Commercial is commerce plus -ial, and the noun behind it means merchandise.
intro.cn: commercial 是 commerce 加 -ial 构成，其名词本义是货物交易。

items.en: Merx meant goods, and commercium meant trade.
items.cn: merx 意为货物，commercium 意为交易。

items.en: French commercial described matters of trade.
items.cn: 法语 commercial 用来描述与贸易有关的事务。

items.en: English commercial first appeared in writing about trade law.
items.cn: 英语 commercial 最早出现在关于贸易法的文字中。

items.en: It widened to banks, vehicles and anything done for profit.
items.cn: 它的范围扩展到银行、车辆以及任何以营利为目的的事物。

items.en: Radio and television gave the word its noun sense, an advertisement.
items.cn: 广播与电视赋予了它名词义，即广告。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers adjectives ending in the same sound, while the meaning group names trade words and advertisements.
note.cn: 形近组收的是结尾读音相同的形容词，近义组列出贸易词与广告词。

relating to people living together
approved by a person in authority
relating to trade and merchants
busy with buying and selling
a notice that promotes a product

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a street of shops, then move to the motive of profit and to the ad that interrupts a film.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一条店铺林立的街开始，再走到营利的动机与打断影片的广告。

normal.en: Commerce is the noun, commercial is the adjective, and the ad sense came later.
normal.cn: commerce 是名词，commercial 是形容词，广告义是后来才有的。

normal.en: A commercial break is literally a break paid for by traders.
normal.cn: 广告时段字面上就是商人付钱买下的间歇。

normal.en: Commercial success measures money, not quality.
normal.cn: 商业上的成功衡量的是钱，而不是质量。

normal.en: A commercial bank serves ordinary customers, not only governments.
normal.cn: 商业银行服务普通客户，而不只是政府。

normal.en: Add -ize and something becomes a business.
normal.cn: 加上 -ize，某事物就变成了一门生意。

abstract.en: Picture a street where every window is a shop window.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街，每扇窗都是橱窗。

abstract.en: Picture a film freezing while a voice praises soap.
abstract.cn: 想象影片定格，一个声音在夸肥皂。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag hanging from a painting.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画上挂着价签。

examples.en: The commercial broke the film into three parts.
examples.cn: 这段广告把影片切成了三段。

examples.en: They turned the old house into commercial offices.
examples.cn: 他们把老房子改成了商业办公室。

examples.en: The play was a commercial success but a critical failure.
examples.cn: 这部戏在商业上成功，评价却很糟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 commercial 记成 commerce（商业）加 ial：与商业有关的，就是商业的，也指插播的广告。

root: 由 commerce 加形容词后缀 -ial 构成，词根上溯拉丁语 merx（货物）与 commercium（交易），本义是与买卖有关的。

sensesIntro.en: From anything connected with trade, to anything done for profit, and finally to the ad that pays for broadcasting.
sensesIntro.cn: 从与贸易有关，到为营利而做，再到为播出付费的广告。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a film stopped for thirty seconds while someone sells something.
core.cn: 核心意象：电视节目被一段广告突然打断的那三十秒。

branches.en: The plain trade sense is the base adjective meaning.
branches.cn: 普通的贸易义是这个词的基础形容词义。

branches.en: Profit is the purpose behind trade, so the word also judges intent.
branches.cn: 利润是贸易背后的目的，所以这个词也评判意图。

branches.en: The noun sense came from radio and television schedules.
branches.cn: 名词义来自广播与电视的节目安排。

branches.en: A commercial street and a commercial film share one motive.
branches.cn: 商业街与商业片共享同一个动机。

branches.en: An ad is the profit motive squeezed into thirty seconds.
branches.cn: 广告就是把营利动机压缩进三十秒。

intro.en: Commercial is an -ial adjective, and its family shares the root of commerce.
intro.cn: commercial 是带 -ial 的形容词，家族与 commerce 共用同一个词根。

latinIntro.en: The Latin merc- for goods also underlies merchant and market.
latinIntro.cn: 表示货物的拉丁词根 merc- 也支撑着 merchant 与 market。

items.example: The show has long commercial breaks.
items.exampleCN: 这个节目广告时段很长。

items.meaning: in terms of trade or profit
items.example: The drug is not commercially available.
items.exampleCN: 这种药在商业渠道买不到。

items.meaning: to turn something into a business
items.example: They commercialized the village festival.
items.exampleCN: 他们把村里的节日商业化了。

items.meaning: the process of becoming a business
items.example: Critics fear the commercialization of sport.
items.exampleCN: 批评者担心体育被商业化。

items.example: The novel attacks modern commercialism.
items.exampleCN: 这部小说抨击现代商业主义。

items.example: Commerce links the two regions.
items.exampleCN: 商业把这两个地区连在一起。

items.structure: related noun from the same root
items.example: The merchant sold spices and cloth.
items.exampleCN: 这位商人卖香料和布匹。

items.example: It is a non-commercial radio station.
items.exampleCN: 这是一家非商业性电台。

definition_en: money paid to someone for making a sale, an official group given a task, or to order a piece of work
core_image: 成交之后从货款里抽出的那一小份酬劳
scene: 房产中介签下合同，按比例拿到一笔报酬。She earns a small commission on every sale.
sceneCN: 这里 commission 指「佣金」（第 1 个义项：按成交额抽取的报酬）；句意是她每做成一笔买卖都能拿到一小笔佣金。

senses.title: Payment for a sale
senses.definition: a sum of money paid to a salesperson for each deal they complete
senses.definitionCN: 按成交笔数付给销售人员的报酬
senses.example: The agent takes five percent commission.
senses.exampleCN: 中介抽取百分之五的佣金。
senses.why: The word first meant something entrusted, and a share of a deal is entrusted to the seller.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指被托付之物，而成交后分给卖方的一份正是被托付的。

senses.title: An official group
senses.definition: a group of people formally asked to study a problem and report
senses.definitionCN: 受正式委派研究问题并提交报告的团体
senses.example: A commission was set up to study the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 一个委员会被设立来调查这起事故。
senses.why: A task is entrusted to a group, so the group itself takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 任务被托付给一群人，于是这群人本身也得了这个名字。

senses.title: To order a work
senses.definition: to formally ask someone to produce a piece of work
senses.definitionCN: 正式请某人创作或完成一项作品
senses.example: The city commissioned a new bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市委托建造了一座新桥。
senses.why: To commission is to entrust the making of something to another person.
senses.whyCN: 委托就是把某物的制作托付给别人。

intro.en: Commission comes from Latin commissio, a handing over, from committere, to entrust.
intro.cn: commission 来自拉丁语 commissio（交托），源自 committere（托付）。

items.en: Committere joined com-, together, with mittere, to send.
items.cn: committere 把表示一起的 com- 与表示送出的 mittere 结合。

items.en: Commissio named the act of entrusting a task.
items.cn: commissio 指把任务托付出去的行为。

items.en: Old French commission carried the sense of an authority given.
items.cn: 古法语 commission 带有授予权限的含义。

items.en: English commission first meant a formal order of authority.
items.cn: 英语 commission 最初指正式的授权命令。

items.en: It split into a group, a share of a sale and the act of ordering work.
items.cn: 它分化为委员会、销售提成与委托创作三个义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words ending in the same sound as commission, while the meaning group names fees and formal bodies.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 commission 结尾同音的词，近义组列出酬金与正式机构。

the right to do something given by others

money paid for a service

entries.definition: to give official power to do something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with money handed over after a deal, then move to a group given a task and to the act of ordering work.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从成交后交出的一份钱开始，再走到受派办事的团体与委托创作。

normal.en: Everything commissioned is handed over to someone, and the word keeps that idea.
normal.cn: 凡是被 commission 的事都交托给了某人，这个词一直保留这个意思。

normal.en: A salesperson on commission is paid only when a deal closes.
normal.cn: 按提成计酬的销售，只有成交才有钱。

normal.en: A commission of inquiry is a group entrusted with finding the truth.
normal.cn: 调查委员会就是被托付去寻找真相的一群人。

normal.en: Out of commission means the machine can no longer be sent to work.
normal.cn: 出故障的意思是这台机器再也派不上用场。

normal.en: Commissioner adds -er and becomes the person in charge.
normal.cn: commissioner 加 -er，成了负责的那个人。

abstract.en: Picture a small envelope of cash slid across a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一个装现金的小信封被推过桌面。

abstract.en: Picture five people around a table with one shared file.
abstract.cn: 想象五个人围桌而坐，共用一份文件。

abstract.en: Picture an artist receiving a letter that begins with a request.
abstract.cn: 想象一位画家收到一封以请求开头的信。

examples.en: She earns a small commission on every sale.
examples.cn: 她每成交一笔都能拿到一小笔佣金。

examples.en: The government commissioned a report on housing.
examples.cn: 政府委托撰写了一份关于住房的报告。

examples.en: A commission will review the new rules.
examples.cn: 一个委员会将审议这些新规定。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 commission 记成 com（一起）加 mission（任务）：任务一起交给你，办成了再分一份钱，就是佣金。

root: 源自拉丁语 committere（托付），由 com-（一起）与 mittere（送出）构成，本义是把事情交出去，后引申为委托、委员会与佣金。

sensesIntro.en: From a task entrusted to a person, to a group entrusted with it, and to the money or work such trust brings.
sensesIntro.cn: 从托付给人的任务，到受托付的团体，再到这份托付带来的钱与工作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a share of the money set aside and handed over after a deal.
core.cn: 核心意象：成交之后从货款里抽出的那一小份酬劳。

branches.en: The money sense is the one most people meet at work.
branches.cn: 佣金义是多数人在工作中最先接触到的。

branches.en: A group that receives a task ends up carrying its name.
branches.cn: 接受任务的团体最终承袭了这个名字。

branches.en: The verb keeps the oldest idea: to hand a job to someone.
branches.cn: 动词义保留了最古老的意思：把活儿交给别人。

branches.en: A commissioned report is often written for a commission.
branches.cn: 受委托的报告常常正是为一个委员会而写。

branches.en: Both a fee and an order are forms of entrusting.
branches.cn: 酬金与委托都是托付的不同形式。

intro.en: Commission is a noun and verb from one Latin stem, and it builds agent nouns with -er.
intro.cn: commission 由同一拉丁词干派生出名词与动词，并用 -er 构成施动名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mittere, to send, also underlies commit, mission and permit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送出）也支撑着 commit、mission 与 permit。

items.meaning: formally asked to do a piece of work

items.meaning: the act of ordering work or putting a system into use

items.meaning: a person in charge of a commission or department

items.exampleCN: 专员回答了一个小时的问题。

definition_zh: 承诺；投入；犯（错误或罪行）；托付
definition_en: to promise firmly to do something, to do something wrong, or to give your time and effort fully to something
core_image: 把自己整个人押在一件事上，不再回头
scene: 他在合同上签下名字，答应投入整整两年。She committed herself to the project for two years.
sceneCN: 这里 commit 指「承诺；投入」（第 1 个义项：下定决心去做）；句意是她承诺为这个项目投入两年。

senses.title: To promise firmly
senses.definition: to decide to do something and give it your full effort
senses.definitionCN: 下定决心去做某事并全力以赴
senses.example: She committed herself to the project for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 她承诺为这个项目投入两年。
senses.why: To commit is to hand yourself over, and a promise does exactly that.
senses.whyCN: commit 就是把自己交出去，而承诺做的正是这件事。

senses.title: To do something wrong
senses.definition: to carry out a crime, a mistake or a foolish act
senses.definitionCN: 做出罪行、错误或愚蠢的举动
senses.example: He committed a serious error in the report.
senses.exampleCN: 他在报告里犯了一个严重的错误。
senses.why: A wrong act is also something you hand over to the record, so the word is used for crimes.
senses.whyCN: 错事同样是你交给记录的东西，因此这个词也用于犯罪。

senses.title: To send for treatment
senses.definition: to order someone to be kept in a hospital or prison
senses.definitionCN: 下令把某人送进医院或监狱
senses.example: The judge committed him to prison for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 法官判他入狱一年。
senses.why: The old sense of handing a person over survives in courts and hospitals.
senses.whyCN: 把人交出去的古老含义在法庭与医院里留存下来。

intro.en: Commit comes from Latin committere, to bring together or entrust.
intro.cn: commit 来自拉丁语 committere，意为把事物合在一起或托付出去。

items.en: Committere joined com-, together, with mittere, to send.
items.cn: committere 把表示一起的 com- 与表示送出的 mittere 结合。

items.en: It described handing a person or task into another's charge.
items.cn: 它描述把人或任务交到别人手中。

items.en: Old French commettre kept the sense of entrusting and of doing wrong.
items.cn: 古法语 commettre 兼具托付与做错事两种含义。

items.en: English commit covered both handing over and carrying out an act.
items.cn: 英语 commit 既指交出，也指实施某个行为。

items.en: The modern word centres on promises, effort and wrongdoing.
items.cn: 现代英语中它聚焦于承诺、投入与过失。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words shaped like commit, while the meaning group lists verbs of promising and devoting.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 commit 形状相近的短词，近义组列出承诺与投入的动词。

to agree that something is true

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with signing away your own time, then move to wrong acts and to being handed into a prison.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从签下自己的时间开始，再走到错事与被送进监狱。

normal.en: Commit is to send yourself into something with no way back.
normal.cn: commit 就是把自己送进去，不留退路。

normal.en: The doubled t appears in committed and committing, but not in commit.
normal.cn: committed 与 committing 双写 t，但 commit 本身不双写。

normal.en: You commit a crime or an error, and you commit to a person or plan.
normal.cn: 你犯下罪行或错误，也把自己承诺给某个人或计划。

normal.en: Commit to memory means sending a fact into lasting storage.
normal.cn: 牢记就是把一个事实送进长期存储。

normal.en: A committed teacher gives more than the timetable asks.
normal.cn: 一位尽心尽力的老师，付出的比课表要求的多。

abstract.en: Picture a signature pressed hard enough to mark the page below.
abstract.cn: 想象签名用力到在下一页留下印痕。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy door closing behind a person.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇沉重的门在人身后关上。

abstract.en: Picture a candle burning at only one end, deliberately.
abstract.cn: 想象一支蜡烛被刻意只在一头燃烧。

examples.en: He committed himself to training every morning.
examples.cn: 他坚持每天早上训练。

examples.en: The clerk committed a small error in the list.
examples.cn: 职员在名单上犯了个小错。

examples.en: They committed the old files to memory.
examples.cn: 他们把旧档案牢牢记住。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 commit 记成 com（一起）加 mit（送出）：把自己整个送出去，就是承诺与投入。

root: 源自拉丁语 committere，com- 表示一起，mittere 表示送出，本义是交出去、托付，后引申为承诺投入与犯错。

sensesIntro.en: From handing yourself over to a task, to handing a wrong act to the record, and to handing a person into custody.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把自己交给一项任务，到把错事交给记录，再到把人交入监管。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: staking your whole self on one thing with no way back.
core.cn: 核心意象：把自己整个人押在一件事上，不再回头。

branches.en: The promise sense is the everyday modern one.
branches.cn: 承诺义是现代最日常的义项。

branches.en: A crime is an act handed over to the record.
branches.cn: 罪行就是被交给记录的行为。

branches.en: Courts still use the old sense of handing a person over.
branches.cn: 法庭至今仍用「把人交出去」这个古老义项。

branches.en: Both a promise and a crime are acts you cannot easily undo.
branches.cn: 承诺与罪行都是不易撤回的行为。

branches.en: Devotion and custody both begin with a transfer of control.
branches.cn: 投入与收押都始于控制权的转移。

intro.en: Commit builds nouns with -ment and -al, and its past forms double the final t.
intro.cn: commit 用 -ment 与 -al 构成名词，过去式与分词双写词尾的 t。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mittere, to send, also appears in mission, permit and submit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送出）也出现在 mission、permit 与 submit 之中。

items.meaning: promises, or does a wrong act
items.example: He commits one hour a day to reading.
items.exampleCN: 他每天拿出一小时读书。

items.meaning: gave full effort or carried out an act
items.example: They committed more money to the plan.

definition_en: a promise to do something, steady dedication to a cause, or a duty that you must carry out

senses.title: A promise to do something
senses.definition: a firm promise that you will do something
senses.definitionCN: 坚定地答应去做某事的保证
senses.example: She made a commitment to call her parents weekly.
senses.exampleCN: 她承诺每周给父母打电话。
senses.why: The -ment ending turns the act of committing into the thing promised.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ment 把承诺的动作变成被承诺下来的那件事。

senses.title: Dedication
senses.definition: steady effort and loyalty given to a person, job or cause
senses.definitionCN: 对某人、某项工作或事业持续付出的努力与忠诚
senses.example: The team showed real commitment during the long season.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍在漫长的赛季里表现出真正的投入。
senses.why: A promise kept day after day becomes visible dedication.
senses.whyCN: 一天天兑现的承诺，就变成了看得见的投入。

senses.title: A duty you must carry out
senses.definition: an obligation that takes your time and cannot be ignored
senses.definitionCN: 占用你的时间且无法回避的义务
senses.example: He has family commitments this weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 他这周末有家里的事务要处理。
senses.why: Each promise creates a duty, and the word names those duties in the plural.
senses.whyCN: 每个承诺都造出一份义务，这个词用复数来指这些义务。

intro.en: Commitment is commit plus -ment, the ending that turns an action into a thing.
intro.cn: commitment 由 commit 加 -ment 构成，词尾把动作变成事物。

items.en: Committere meant to entrust or hand over.
items.cn: committere 意为托付或交出。

items.en: Old French commettre supplied the verb commit.
items.cn: 古法语 commettre 提供了动词 commit。

items.en: English commit covered entrusting and carrying out acts.
items.cn: 英语 commit 兼指托付与实施行为。

items.en: Commitment appeared as the state of being pledged.
items.cn: commitment 出现，表示已被许诺约束的状态。

items.en: It widened to mean loyalty to work, people and causes.
items.cn: 它的含义扩展到对工作、他人与事业的忠诚。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns built on the commit stem, while the meaning group names promises and duties.
note.cn: 形近组收的是建立在 commit 词干上的名词，近义组列出承诺与义务。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a spoken promise, then move to daily dedication and to the duties that pile up around it.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一句说出口的承诺开始，再走到日复一日的投入与由此堆积的事务。

normal.en: Commit is the act, commitment is the thing you are now held to.
normal.cn: commit 是动作，commitment 是你此后必须遵守的那件事。

normal.en: A commitment kept for years looks exactly like dedication.
normal.cn: 坚持多年的承诺，看起来就是投入。

normal.en: Make a commitment, then honour it: two verbs, one promise.
normal.cn: 作出承诺，然后履行承诺：两个动作，一个诺言。

normal.en: Commitments in the plural often means a crowded calendar.
normal.cn: 复数形式的承诺，常常意味着排得满满的日程。

normal.en: The doubled t of commit stays in commitment.
normal.cn: commit 的双写 t 在 commitment 里保留下来。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised in a quiet room to say yes.
abstract.cn: 想象一只在安静的房间里举起的手，说出我愿意。

abstract.en: Picture a runner training on the same track in the rain.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者在雨中跑同一条跑道。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar filled with names and dates.
abstract.cn: 想象一本写满人名与日期的日历。

examples.en: She made a commitment to finish the course.
examples.cn: 她承诺要完成这门课程。

examples.en: The job demands real commitment from every member.
examples.cn: 这份工作要求每位成员真正投入。

examples.en: He has too many commitments to travel this month.
examples.cn: 他这个月事务太多，没法出行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 commitment 记成 commit（承诺）加 ment（事情）：承诺下来的那件事，就是你要背起的责任。

root: 由 commit 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，词根上溯拉丁语 committere（托付），本义是被交托下来的事，后指承诺与投入。

sensesIntro.en: From a promise in words, to the effort that keeps it, and finally to the duties it creates.
sensesIntro.cn: 从口头说出的承诺，到维持它的付出，再到它带来的义务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a promise spoken once and never taken back.
core.cn: 核心意象：说出口就不再收回的那句保证。

branches.en: The promise itself is the sense that names the word.
branches.cn: 承诺本身是这个词最直接的义项。

branches.en: Kept promises turn into visible dedication.
branches.cn: 被兑现的承诺会变成看得见的投入。

branches.en: In the plural the word means the duties filling your week.
branches.cn: 用复数时，这个词指填满你一周的那些事务。

branches.en: A promise and the effort behind it are one thing seen twice.
branches.cn: 承诺与它背后的付出，是同一件事的两次显现。

branches.en: Dedication to work and family duties often compete for the same hours.
branches.cn: 对工作的投入与家庭事务常常争夺同样的时间。

intro.en: Commitment is a -ment noun, and it keeps the doubled t of its verb.
intro.cn: commitment 是带 -ment 的名词，并保留了动词双写的 t。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mittere, to send, links commitment with mission and submit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送出）把 commitment 与 mission、submit 连在一起。

definition_en: a group of people chosen to make decisions or do a particular job for a larger organization
core_image: 长桌旁围坐一圈、举手投票的一群人
scene: 几个人围着长桌，为活动方案投票表决。The committee met on Monday to review the plan.
sceneCN: 这里 committee 指「委员会」（第 1 个义项：受选处理事务的团体）；句意是委员会周一开会审议这个方案。

senses.title: A group chosen to decide
senses.definition: a group of people appointed by a larger body to decide or manage something
senses.definitionCN: 由更大机构委派来决策或管理事务的一群人
senses.example: The committee approved the new budget.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会批准了新预算。
senses.why: A task is committed to a group, and the group takes the name of that trust.
senses.whyCN: 任务被托付给一群人，这群人便承接了这份托付的名字。

senses.title: A smaller working group
senses.definition: a small group formed inside an organization for one particular job
senses.definitionCN: 在组织内部为某项具体工作而设的小组
senses.example: A sports committee organized the summer games.
senses.exampleCN: 一个体育小组筹办了夏季运动会。
senses.why: Large bodies split tasks among small groups, and each is still a committee.
senses.whyCN: 大机构把任务分给小组，每个小组仍称作委员会。

intro.en: Committee is a Middle English noun from the verb commit, meaning a person to whom something is committed.
intro.cn: committee 是中古英语名词，出自动词 commit，本指被托付事务的人。

items.en: Committere meant to entrust something to someone.
items.cn: committere 意为把某事托付给某人。

items.en: Old French commettre and its noun forms carried the sense of trust.
items.cn: 古法语 commettre 及其名词形式都带有信任与托付之意。

items.en: A committe was first one person entrusted with a matter.
items.cn: 最初 committe 指受托办理某事的一个人。

items.en: The meaning shifted from one person to a whole body of people.
items.cn: 词义从一个人转移到一整群人的机构。

items.en: Committee now names any appointed decision-making group.
items.cn: 如今 committee 指任何受委派的决策团体。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns that echo the commit stem, while the meaning group names other decision-making bodies.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 commit 词干相呼应的名词，近义组列出其他决策机构。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a circle of chairs, then move to the trust behind the title and to smaller working groups.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一圈椅子开始，再走到名称背后的托付与更小的工作组。

normal.en: Set up a committee whenever a job is too big for one desk.
normal.cn: 一项工作一张桌子办不完，就成立一个委员会。

normal.en: Two e and two t hide inside committee.
normal.cn: committee 里藏着两个 e 和两个 t。

abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌，八把椅子，一盏灯。

abstract.cn: 想象表决时一只只手缓缓举起。

abstract.cn: 想象一个文件夹在成员之间传递。

examples.cn: 委员会周一开会审议这个方案。

examples.cn: 各委员会下个月提交报告。

root: 由动词 commit 派生而来，词根为拉丁语 committere（托付），本义是被托付事务的人，后转指受委派的团体。

sensesIntro.en: From one trusted person, to the body that decides, and finally to any small group given a single job.
sensesIntro.cn: 从受信任的一个人，到作出决定的机构，再到承担单项任务的小组。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle of people around a long table, raising hands to decide.
core.cn: 核心意象：长桌旁围坐一圈、举手投票的一群人。

branches.en: The decision-making body is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 决策机构是今天的主要义项。

branches.en: A small group inside an organization is the same idea at smaller scale.
branches.cn: 组织内部的小组，是同一想法在更小尺度上的体现。

branches.en: Both a national body and a school group work by meeting.
branches.cn: 全国性机构与校内小组都靠开会运作。

branches.en: Size changes, but the trust placed in the group does not.
branches.cn: 规模会变，但托付给这群人的信任不变。

branches.en: The smallest committee is often the one that gets things done.
branches.cn: 最小的委员会往往才是真正把事办成的那个。

intro.en: Committee is a noun from commit, and it keeps the doubled t in the singular and plural.
intro.cn: committee 是由 commit 派生的名词，单复数都保留双写的 t。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mittere, to send, sits under the whole commit family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送出）支撑着整个 commit 家族。

definition_en: happening often, shared by many people, or ordinary and not special
core_image: 街角人人都走的那条普通小路
scene: 这种鸟在城里随处可见，几乎每个公园都有。Rain is common here in early summer.
sceneCN: 这里 common 指「常见的」（第 1 个义项：经常出现）；句意是初夏时节这里常下雨。

senses.title: Happening often
senses.definition: existing or happening very often in a place or group
senses.definitionCN: 在某地或某群体中经常出现或发生
senses.example: Heavy rain is common in this region.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区常下大雨。
senses.why: The Latin root meant shared, and what many share is what happens often.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为共有，而多数人共有的东西就是经常出现的东西。

senses.title: Shared by many
senses.definition: belonging to or used by two or more people together
senses.definitionCN: 由两人或更多人共同拥有或使用的
senses.example: The two neighbours share a common wall.
senses.exampleCN: 这两家邻居共用一堵墙。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: communis meant belonging to all.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：communis 意为属于所有人。

senses.title: Ordinary, not special
senses.definition: plain and usual, without any special quality
senses.definitionCN: 平常的，没有特别之处的
senses.example: It was just a common chair, nothing rare.
senses.exampleCN: 那只是一把普通的椅子，没什么稀奇。
senses.why: What belongs to everyone is also nothing special, so shared becomes plain.
senses.whyCN: 属于所有人的东西也就不稀奇，于是共有变成了普通。

intro.en: Common comes from Latin communis, shared by all, through Old French comun.
intro.cn: common 经古法语 comun 上溯拉丁语 communis，意为众人共有。

items.en: Communis meant shared or belonging to all.
items.cn: communis 意为共有的或属于所有人的。

items.en: Communitas named the community that holds things in common.
items.cn: communitas 指共有事物的共同体。

items.en: Old French comun described what many people share.
items.cn: 古法语 comun 描述许多人共有的东西。

items.en: English common covered shared land and shared customs.
items.cn: 英语 common 既指共有的土地，也指共同的习俗。

items.en: It widened to mean frequent and also plain.
items.cn: 它的含义扩展到频繁出现以及平常普通。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close in spelling to common, while the meaning group names what is usual.

normal.en: Communis means shared, so common things belong to everyone, including habits.

normal.en: In common is the phrase for what two people share.

normal.en: Common sense is judgement shared by most people.

normal.en: The comparative is commoner, not more common, in careful writing.
normal.cn: 在讲究的写作里，比较级用 commoner，而不用 more common。

normal.cn: 加上 un-，罕见的意思就出现了：uncommon。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a well-worn path at a street corner that everyone uses.

branches.en: Shared ownership is the oldest sense and still very alive.

branches.en: What is shared by all loses any mark of specialness.

branches.en: A common habit is a habit many people share.
branches.cn: 常见的习惯就是许多人共有的习惯。

intro.en: Common is an adjective base that grows with -ly, -ness, un- and compound forms.

latinIntro.en: The Latin communis, shared, also gives community and communicate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 communis（共有）也给出了 community 与 communicate。

definition_en: to share information or feelings with others, or to be connected through an opening or passage
core_image: 两端之间架起一条能让意思顺利通过的电话线
scene: 她用手势和眼神把意思传给对面的同伴。They communicate through short messages every day.
sceneCN: 这里 communicate 指「交流；传达」（第 1 个义项：交换信息）；句意是他们每天靠短消息交流。

senses.title: To share information
senses.definition: to give and receive information with other people
senses.definitionCN: 与他人互相传递和接收信息
senses.example: The two teams communicate by radio.
senses.exampleCN: 两队之间用无线电联络。
senses.why: The Latin root meant to share, and sharing information is its first job.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为分享，而分享信息正是它最首要的功用。

senses.title: To express feelings
senses.definition: to make your thoughts or feelings known to others
senses.definitionCN: 让他人知道你的想法或感受
senses.example: Music can communicate joy without words.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐不用词语也能表达喜悦。
senses.why: What is shared is not only facts but also feelings.
senses.whyCN: 被分享的不只是事实，还有感受。

senses.title: To be connected
senses.definition: to be joined through a door, passage or opening
senses.definitionCN: 通过门、通道或开口相连
senses.example: The two rooms communicate through a narrow door.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个房间通过一扇窄门相通。
senses.why: Rooms that connect let things pass, just as people let meaning pass.
senses.whyCN: 相通的房间让东西通过，就像人与人之间让意思通过。

intro.en: Communicate comes from Latin communicare, to share, from communis, common.
intro.cn: communicate 来自拉丁语 communicare（分享），词根是 communis（共有）。

items.en: Communis meant shared by all, and communicare meant to share.
items.cn: communis 意为众人共有，communicare 意为分享。

items.en: Communicare also covered making something common to two parties.
items.cn: communicare 也指让某物为双方所共有。

items.en: French communiquer carried the sense of passing news along.
items.cn: 法语 communiquer 带有把消息传递出去的含义。

items.en: English communicate first meant to share or impart.
items.cn: 英语 communicate 最初表示分享或传授。

items.en: It widened to telephones, letters, gestures and connected rooms.
items.cn: 它的用法扩展到电话、书信、手势以及相通的房间。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers longer verbs near the shape of communicate, while the meaning group lists verbs of passing meaning on.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 communicate 形状相近的较长动词，近义组列出传递意思的动词。

to make something harder
to prepare land for crops
to make an idea understood
to give part of something to others
to exchange letters or messages

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a line carrying meaning, then move to feelings that travel and rooms that connect.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一条传递意思的线开始，再走到流动的情感与相通的房间。

normal.en: The root communis means shared, so to communicate is to make something shared.
normal.cn: 词根 communis 意为共有，所以 communicate 就是让某物被共同拥有。

normal.en: You communicate with a person, and you communicate an idea.
normal.cn: communicate with 接人，communicate 后也可直接接想法。

normal.en: Music communicates what a sentence cannot.
normal.cn: 音乐能传达一句话做不到的东西。

normal.en: The ending -ate marks the verb, -ion makes the noun.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ate 标记动词，换成 -ion 就成了名词。

normal.en: Two rooms that communicate share a door, not a wall.
normal.cn: 相通的房间共享一扇门，而不是一堵墙。

abstract.en: Picture a wire humming between two windows.
abstract.cn: 想象一根电线在两扇窗之间嗡鸣。

abstract.en: Picture a face saying more than a long letter.
abstract.cn: 想象一张脸比一封长信说得更多。

abstract.en: Picture a small door hidden in a thick wall.
abstract.cn: 想象厚墙上藏着一扇小门。

examples.en: They communicate through short messages every day.
examples.cn: 他们每天靠短消息交流。

examples.en: A good teacher communicates ideas simply.
examples.cn: 好老师能把想法讲得简单明白。

examples.en: The kitchen communicates with the dining room.
examples.cn: 厨房与餐厅相通。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 communicate 记成 com（一起）加 mun（共有）加 icate：把东西变成大家共有，就是交流传达。

root: 源自拉丁语 communicare（分享），词根 communis 意为共有，本义是使某物为大家共同拥有，后引申为交流、表达与相通。

sensesIntro.en: From sharing facts, to sharing feelings, and finally to rooms that share an opening.
sensesIntro.cn: 从分享事实，到分享感受，再到共享一个开口的房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line laid between two points so that meaning can pass through.
core.cn: 核心意象：两端之间架起一条能让意思顺利通过的电话线。

branches.en: Sharing information is the core modern sense.
branches.cn: 分享信息是现代核心义项。

branches.en: Feelings travel the same line as facts.
branches.cn: 情感与事实走的是同一条线路。

branches.en: Connected rooms show the physical origin of sharing.
branches.cn: 相通的房间体现了「共享」的物理来源。

branches.en: Both a fact and a feeling need a listener to be complete.
branches.cn: 事实与感受都需要一个听者才算完成。

branches.en: A passage and a message both let something through.
branches.cn: 通道与消息都让某物通过。

intro.en: Communicate is a verb base whose family grows with -ion, -ive, -or and -able.
intro.cn: communicate 是动词词基，家族靠 -ion、-ive、-or 与 -able 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin communis, shared, also gives common, community and communism.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 communis（共有）也给出了 common、community 与 communism。

items.example: She communicates with the team each morning.
items.exampleCN: 她每天早上与团队沟通。

items.example: The plan was communicated to all staff.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划已传达到全体员工。

items.example: They are communicating by sign language.
items.exampleCN: 他们正用手语交流。

items.meaning: the act or system of sharing information
items.example: Clear communication prevents mistakes.
items.exampleCN: 清晰的沟通能避免错误。

items.example: He is a communicative child.
items.exampleCN: 他是个愿意说话的孩子。

items.meaning: a person who shares ideas well
items.example: She is a fine communicator.
items.exampleCN: 她是一位出色的沟通者。

items.example: The disease is highly communicable.
items.exampleCN: 这种病传染性很强。

items.example: A communication gap caused the delay.
items.exampleCN: 沟通上的隔阂造成了延误。

definition_en: the act of sharing information, a message that is sent, or the systems used to send information
core_image: 两端之间那条不停传递消息的线
scene: 山里信号断了，救援队与外界失去联系。Good communication kept the team working as one.
sceneCN: 这里 communication 指「沟通；交流」（第 1 个义项：信息的交换）；句意是良好的沟通让这支队伍如同一人般协作。

senses.title: The act of exchanging information
senses.definition: the process of giving and receiving information between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间互相传递与接收信息的过程
senses.example: Clear communication prevents many mistakes.
senses.exampleCN: 清晰的沟通能避免许多错误。
senses.why: The -ion ending turns the verb into the whole process it names.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ion 把动词变成了它所指的整个过程。

senses.title: A message
senses.definition: a message or piece of information that is sent to someone
senses.definitionCN: 发送给某人的消息或信息
senses.example: The office received a communication from the bank.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室收到了银行的一封来函。
senses.why: One act of sharing produces one thing shared, and that thing takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 一次分享产生一个被分享的东西，那个东西也用了同一个名字。

senses.title: Systems of sending information
senses.definition: the equipment and networks used to send information over distance
senses.definitionCN: 用于远距离传送信息的设备与网络
senses.example: The storm cut off all communication with the island.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨切断了与这座岛的所有通讯。
senses.why: As technology grew, the word spread from the act to the wires and signals.
senses.whyCN: 随着技术发展，这个词从动作扩展到了线路与信号。

intro.en: Communication is the noun of communicate, built on Latin communicare, to share.
intro.cn: communication 是 communicate 的名词形式，词根为拉丁语 communicare（分享）。

items.en: Communis meant common, and communicare meant to make common.
items.cn: communis 意为共有，communicare 意为使成为共有。

items.en: Communicatio named the act of sharing or exchanging.
items.cn: communicatio 指分享或交换的行为。

items.en: Old French communication kept the sense of mutual sharing.
items.cn: 古法语 communication 保留了互相分享的含义。

items.en: English communication first meant common possession or exchange.
items.cn: 英语 communication 最初指共同拥有或交换。

items.en: It now covers speech, writing, media and entire networks.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖说话、书写、媒体与整套网络。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns from the same verb family, while the meaning group names contact and correspondence.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一动词家族的名词，近义组列出联络与往来。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two people understanding each other, then move to a single message and to the wires of a network.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两人彼此理解开始，再走到一条消息与网络的线路。

normal.en: Communication is what happens when a message arrives and is understood.
normal.cn: 消息抵达并被理解，沟通才算发生。

normal.en: In the plural communications often means the technology of sending news.
normal.cn: 复数形式常指传递消息的技术。

normal.en: Communication skills are judged by the listener, not the speaker.
normal.cn: 沟通技巧的评判者是听者，而不是说者。

normal.en: A storm that cuts communication cuts a whole island off.
normal.cn: 一场切断通讯的风暴，会把整座岛隔绝起来。

normal.en: Change -tion to -te and the verb communicate appears.
normal.cn: 把 -tion 换成 -te，动词 communicate 就出现了。

abstract.en: Picture two people drawing the same shape on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人在纸上画出同一个图形。

abstract.en: Picture a single letter crossing an ocean.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信横渡大洋。

abstract.en: Picture an antenna on a hill pointing at the sky.
abstract.cn: 想象山顶上一根指向天空的天线。

examples.en: Good communication kept the team working as one.
examples.cn: 良好的沟通让这支队伍如同一人般协作。

examples.en: The school sent a communication to every parent.
examples.cn: 学校给每位家长发了一份通知。

examples.en: The storm cut off communication with the island.
examples.cn: 暴风雨切断了与这座岛的通讯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 communication 记成 communicate（交流）加 ion（过程）：把信息变成大家共有的过程，就是沟通。

root: 由 communicate 加名词后缀 -ion 构成，词根上溯拉丁语 communis（共有）与 communicare（分享），本义是共享的过程。

sensesIntro.en: From the process of sharing, to one shared message, and finally to the networks that carry it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从分享的过程，到一条被分享的消息，再到承载它的网络。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line between two points that keeps carrying messages.
core.cn: 核心意象：两端之间那条不停传递消息的线。

branches.en: The process sense is the broadest and most used.
branches.cn: 过程义最宽泛，也用得最多。

branches.en: One message is a single unit produced by that process.
branches.cn: 一条消息是这个过程产出的单个单位。

branches.en: Technology turned the process into cables, towers and networks.
branches.cn: 技术把这个过程变成了电缆、铁塔与网络。

branches.en: A message only counts once the sharing is complete.
branches.cn: 消息只有在分享完成时才算数。

branches.en: Every network exists to carry one message at a time.
branches.cn: 每个网络存在的意义，都是一次送一条消息。

intro.en: Communication is a -tion noun whose family circles around communicate.
intro.cn: communication 是带 -tion 的名词，家族围绕 communicate 展开。

latinIntro.en: The Latin communis, shared, links communication with common and community.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 communis（共有）把 communication 与 common、community 连在一起。

items.meaning: systems and technologies for sending information
items.example: The company runs its own communications network.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司自建通讯网络。

items.example: They communicate mostly by phone.
items.exampleCN: 他们主要靠电话联系。

items.example: The class is lively and communicative.
items.exampleCN: 这个班活跃又善于交流。

items.meaning: a person who gets ideas across
items.example: A leader must be a clear communicator.
items.exampleCN: 领导者必须善于清楚表达。

items.meaning: able to be passed from one to another
items.example: Some fevers are communicable.
items.exampleCN: 有些发热是会传染的。

items.meaning: a failure to understand each other
items.example: A miscommunication delayed the meeting.
items.exampleCN: 一次沟通失误让会议推迟了。

items.example: Telecommunication changed the modern world.
items.exampleCN: 电信改变了现代世界。

items.example: A communication gap split the two teams.
items.exampleCN: 沟通隔阂让两支队伍分裂了。

definition_en: a group of people who live in the same area or share the same interest, religion or way of life
core_image: 一条街上的人共用同一口水井，彼此点头问好
scene: 小区里，邻居们一起清理被风吹倒的树枝。The whole community came out to clear the fallen branches.
sceneCN: 这里 community 指「社区」（第 1 个义项：住在同一片地方的人）；句意是整个社区的人都出来清理倒下的树枝。

senses.title: People of one area
senses.definition: the people who live in one particular area and often share services
senses.definitionCN: 住在某一地区、常常共用设施的一群人
senses.example: The whole community uses the new sports ground.
senses.exampleCN: 整个社区都在使用这块新运动场。
senses.why: People who live close by share roads, shops and schools, so they form a natural unit.
senses.whyCN: 住得近的人共用道路、商店和学校，自然就形成了一个单位。

senses.title: A group with one interest
senses.definition: a group of people who share an interest, a religion or a job
senses.definitionCN: 因共同的兴趣、信仰或职业而聚在一起的一群人
senses.example: She joined the online community for young writers.
senses.exampleCN: 她加入了年轻写作者的线上社群。
senses.why: Shared interest, not shared space, holds this group together.
senses.whyCN: 把这群人连在一起的是共同兴趣，而不是同一片地方。

senses.title: A feeling of belonging
senses.definition: the feeling that you belong to a group and care about its members
senses.definitionCN: 觉得自己属于某个群体并关心其成员的感觉
senses.example: The small school has a real sense of community.
senses.exampleCN: 这所小学校有一种真切的归属感。
senses.why: From shared life comes a shared identity, which people also call community.
senses.whyCN: 共同生活生出共同的身份感，人们也把这叫作 community。

intro.en: Community comes from Latin communis, meaning shared or common, and first named a body of people who held things in common.
intro.cn: community 来自拉丁语 communis，意为共有的、公共的，最初指共同拥有某些东西的一群人。

items.en: Communis meant shared by many, not owned by one.
items.cn: communis 意为由许多人共有，而非一人独享。

items.en: Communitas named the state of sharing and the group that shared.
items.cn: communitas 指共有状态，也指共有东西的那群人。

items.en: Old French communete carried the word into everyday use.
items.cn: 古法语 communete 把这个词带进日常使用。

items.en: English community first meant a body of people with common rights.
items.cn: 英语 community 最初指享有共同权利的一群人。

items.en: It now covers neighbourhoods, online groups and the international community.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖邻里、线上群体以及国际社会。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that echo the shape of community, and the meaning group names other ways of speaking about people who belong together.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 community 形似的词，近义组列出其他指一群人彼此归属的说法。

entries.definition: a group of people who live together and share everything
entries.definitionCN: 共同生活、共享一切的公社

entries.definition: a political system in which property belongs to the state

people living together in an organised way
the area around the place where you live

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a shared well, then move to shared interests and to the feeling of belonging.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从共用一口井开始，再走到共同兴趣与归属感。

normal.en: Com- means together, so a community is people held together by something.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，所以 community 就是被某种东西连在一起的人。

normal.en: Same street gives one kind of community; same hobby gives another.
normal.cn: 同一条街是一种社区，同一个爱好是另一种社区。

normal.en: You can belong to a community without living in it.
normal.cn: 你不必住在其中，也能属于一个社群。

normal.en: Commune and community share the same old root of sharing.
normal.cn: commune 与 community 共享同一个表示共有的古老词根。

normal.en: A sense of community is the warm feeling, not the map.
normal.cn: 归属感是那种温暖的感觉，而不是地图上的界线。

abstract.en: Picture neighbours passing bread over the same low wall.
abstract.cn: 想象邻居隔着同一道矮墙递面包。

abstract.en: Picture a forum where strangers answer a question at midnight.
abstract.cn: 想象一个论坛，陌生人在午夜回答问题。

abstract.en: Picture a whole street sweeping leaves after a storm.
abstract.cn: 想象整条街的人在暴风雨后一起扫落叶。

examples.en: The whole community helped rebuild the damaged school.
examples.cn: 整个社区都来帮忙重建受损的学校。

examples.en: He is well known in the local business community.
examples.cn: 他在当地商业圈里很有名。

examples.en: Online communities let shy people find friends.
examples.cn: 线上社群让害羞的人找到朋友。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 community 记成 com（一起）加 munity：一群人因为共用的东西聚在一起，就是社区。

root: 源自拉丁语 communis（共有的），经 communitas 进入法语与英语，本义是共同拥有某些东西的一群人，后指社区、群体与共同体感。

sensesIntro.en: From people sharing one place, to people sharing one interest, and finally to the warm feeling of belonging.
sensesIntro.cn: 从共居一地的人，到共享一种兴趣的人，最后到那份温暖的归属感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: neighbours around one well, greeting each other by name.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条街上的人共用同一口水井，彼此点头问好。

branches.en: Sharing a place is the oldest sense of community.
branches.cn: 共用一片地方是 community 最古老的义项。

branches.en: Sharing an interest creates a community without walls.
branches.cn: 共享一种兴趣，就能造出没有围墙的社群。

branches.en: The feeling of belonging is the inward side of community.
branches.cn: 归属感是 community 向内的一面。

branches.en: Both rest on something held in common.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在某种共有的东西之上。

branches.en: A group you care about also cares back.
branches.cn: 你在意的群体，也会反过来在意你。

intro.en: Community is built on the Latin base commun- plus the noun ending -ity.
intro.cn: community 由拉丁词基 commun- 加名词后缀 -ity 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin communis supplied the idea of something held in common.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 communis 提供了「共有」这一核心意思。

items.meaning: a person who shares ideas well

definition_en: a business that sells goods or services, or the state of being with other people
core_image: 会议桌旁一群人围着同一份文件讨论
scene: 夜深了，主人留客人在客厅再坐一会儿。I enjoy your company, so please stay a little longer.

senses.title: A business
senses.definition: an organisation that sells goods or services to make money
senses.definitionCN: 以销售商品或服务来盈利的组织
senses.example: She works for a small software company.

abstract.cn: 想象演员在同一束亮光下一起鞠躬。

examples.cn: 她加入了一个巡回剧团。

root: 源自拉丁语 com（一起）与 panis（面包），本义是一起吃面包的人，后指一群人、陪伴与公司。

sensesIntro.en: From people sharing bread, to the group itself, and then to the business that group became.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a group around one long table, passing the same bread.

branches.en: Being with others is the oldest and warmest sense.
branches.cn: 有人相伴是最古老也最温暖的义项。
